question: Who among the following is the author of the novel 'Train to Pakistan'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khuswant Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khushwant Singh**__

 __
 
• Khushwant Singh was an I**ndian journalist, lawyer, and politician**.
 
• In 'Train to Pakistan' he expressed his experiences of the** 1947** Partition.
 
• Between **1980-1986 **he served as a Member of Parliament in **Rajya Sabha**.
 
• Khushwant Singh was awarded the Padma Bhushan in **1974**.
 
• However, he returned the award in **1984** in protest against Operation **Blue Star**.
 
• In 2007 He was awarded Padma Vi-Bhushan.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• His other important books are-

 
 
• The Voice of God and Other Stories, (Short Story) 1957.
 
• Shall Not Hear the Nightingale, 1959.
 
• The Sikhs Today, 1959.
 
• The End of India, 2003.
 
• Burial at the Sea, 2004.
 
• Paradise and Other Stories, 2004.
 
• Gods and Godmen of India, 2012.
